strings.title: {productName} - Crash Report
strings.headline: {productName} hit a snag and had to close.
strings.body: Sorry about that! Sending this report helps our team find and fix the problem faster. It includes technical details about the crash, plus anything you choose to add below.
strings.descriptionLabel: What were you doing when it happened?
strings.descriptionPlaceholder: Anything helps, even "I opened a level."
strings.contactNote: Leave your contact details if you'd like us to follow up. See our privacy policy.
strings.consent: I agree to let {productName} store this report for up to one year.
strings.filesBody: These files are included in the crash report. They describe the state of {productName} when it crashed, along with anything you entered.
